function: LLM-independent Anchor encoding and decoding decision batch engine (Default OFF: deterministic offline) with optional OpenRouter Perplexity Decider V1.2 (default boost provider) or Gemini Decision 1 acceleration.
capabilities: Deterministic offline Anchor polarity, opcode, and rule-economy decision solver (Default OFF for Decider AI)
Single-pass OpenRouter Perplexity Decider V1.2 (perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2, default boost provider) and Flash V1.2 noul, choice, and score batching
Single-pass Gemini Decision 1 (gemini-decision-1 via v1beta/decisions) selectable Decider option
Calibrated confidence gating that turns low-confidence classifications into explicit unknowns
adaptation: Recommended optional decision optimization ingredient whenever a recipe involves Anchor coding (coding around set Anchors). Decider speedup is OFF by default (DETERMINISTIC_OFFLINE with zero LLM or network) and recommended if the host has an OpenRouter API key. When enabled, defaults to OpenRouter (perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2) with Gemini (gemini-decision-1) also selectable. Advisory only; confers no execution or Baker authority.
verified_with: tests/test_anchor_decision_boost.py; deterministic offline solver, OpenRouter pplx-decider-v1.2 and Gemini gemini-decision-1 calibration fixtures
provenance: Native MantleOS/KPP shared Anchor decision optimization ingredient.

usage.use_when: Recommended optional ingredient (Default OFF) whenever a recipe involves Anchor coding (coding around set Anchors) — especially when an OpenRouter API key or openrouter-mind is used — with selectable OpenRouter (default: perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2) or Gemini (gemini-decision-1) acceleration.
inputs: Candidate source or scan units, Anchor design or recipe contract, optional OpenRouter pplx-decider-v1.2 or gemini-decision-1 responses
outputs: Validated anchor.design/1, Molecule entries, decision batches, and routed decode dispositions
usage.limits: Up to 128 candidate units and 1000 closed-ended questions per batch; model outputs are model_inferred with authority NONE and never bypass deterministic validation or Baker acceptance.
